Ignyte Yoga. What's Your Why?
pages.description: Ignyte Yoga is a family-owned, family-run infrared yoga studio that embraces and celebrates all skill levels - from beginner to advanced. Ignyte Yoga is one of the original infrared hot yoga studios in Frisco. We're conveniently located off of Dallas Parkway and offer flow classes, power yoga, and weight-cardio fusion classes for all levels!
